data.desc: MNTN (NYSE: MNTN) is the Hardest Working Software in Television, bringing unrivaled performance and simplicity to Connected TV advertising. Our self-serve technology makes running TV ads as easy as search and social and helps brands drive measurable conversions, revenue, site visits, and more. MNTN was named one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and Next Big Things in Tech, and was recently featured on the cover of INC's Best in Business Issue. For more information, please visit https://mntn.com/.
